title: Flogging and Scourging
summary: Flogging and scourging were severe forms of punishment used by authorities before or after legal decisions.
background: The Gospels and Acts show physical punishment as part of public shame, coercion, and suffering. Roman and Jewish settings could differ in form and legal limits.
teachingHelp: When teaching these passages, do not rush past the bodily suffering; yet point to Christ’s endurance and the apostles’ witness under persecution.
